newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Sri Lanka stocks close up in active trade.
newsitem.headline: Sri Lanka stocks close up in active trade.

text.p: Sri Lanka stocks closed higher in active trade on Tuesday, although gains were restrained by a lack of sellers, brokers said.
The all share index closed 2.3 points up at 636.6 with price gains outnumbering losses by 27 to six. Ceylon Brewery rose one rupee to 39, John Keells Holdings 50 cents to 200.50.
"There was foreign buying of selected blue chips today since we were lucky enough to locate sellers," said a trader at brokerage Jardine Fleming.
Turnover was 44.3 million rupees on 933,859 shares.
The main trades were foreign buying of 50,100 Development Finance Corporation, 30,100 John Keells Holdings and 125,000 Richard Pieris & Co.
"It is difficult to trade with buyers sometimes holding out for about five percent over market rates," said Dihan Dedigama, a trader at brokerage John Keells.
Buyers who were on the sidelines ahead of last week's local govrnment elections, have returned to the market, but failed to meet up with sellers who are asking for premiums, brokers say.
